correctness.rationale: The 24 vertices, 36 edges and even/odd inversion bipartition are explicit. Every matching is enumerated uniquely by branching on the least uncovered vertex, yielding 169. Alternating cycles after contracting matching edges correspond exactly to directed cycles, and deleting nonmatching edges that hit every alternating cycle equals minimum feedback arc deletion. The subset dynamic program minimizes backward arcs over every topological order, so its 4096-state answer is an exact optimum. Independent private code rebuilt all 169 matchings from scratch, recomputed the complete coefficient table, generated all 48 group maps, 17 symmetry orbits, and checked the entire orbit-size/anti-forcing/two-factor-type table term by term against the claim. The source also supplies an independent hitting-set method for 17 orbit representatives; its code was read but the latter method was not independently reimplemented this execution. Exhaustion is genuinely finite here.
residual_risks: The table is tied to the explicitly defined 48-element subgroup and exact 24-vertex graph; it is not a classification of all truncated-octahedral graph variants or all (4,6)-fullerenes.
